scripts.sync:sources: sh -c 'f=../ragrun/.env; [ -f "$f" ] || f=../.env; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "ragkeep: ragrun .env not found" >&2; exit 1; }; exec node --env-file "$f" --import tsx ./scripts/sync_sources.ts --all'
scripts.upload:covers: sh -c 'f=../ragrun/.env; [ -f "$f" ] || f=../.env; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "ragkeep: ragrun .env not found" >&2; exit 1; }; exec node --env-file "$f" --import tsx ./scripts/upload_covers.ts --all'
scripts.build:registry: sh -c 'f=../ragrun/.env; [ -f "$f" ] || f=../.env; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "ragkeep: ragrun .env not found (tried ../ragrun/.env and ../.env)" >&2; exit 1; }; exec node --env-file "$f" --import tsx ./scripts/build_agent_registry.ts'
